stem: The 95% interval for the difference in conversion, treatment minus control, runs from +0.15 to +0.85 percentage points. Which conclusion fits?

options.text: Not significant, because the interval is wider than its own midpoint of 0.50
Significant at 5%; the true lift is plausibly 0.15 to 0.85 points
Significant at 5%, and conversion rose by 0.15% to 0.85% relative to control
There is a 95% chance that the true lift is exactly 0.50 percentage points
